message: Thanks. A few questions: How many people live in your household? How many children under 18 live with you, and is anyone pregnant or is there a baby under 1? Is anyone 65 or older, or disabled? Roughly how much does the household earn from work per year before tax? Does anyone get health insurance through a job?
reply: Three of us. One kid. No. Nope. Nope. Somewhere between 55 thousand and 65 thousand a year. No.

summary: IL family of 3 (married couple, 1 child), income ~$55-65k, no employer insurance. Child likely eligible for CHIP (IL limit ~318% FPL); parents likely eligible for ACA premium tax credit. Over limits for SNAP, school meals, Medicaid (adults), TANF. EITC borderline at this income and CTC refundable portion unlikely, so not recommended.
